Enterprise Identity & SSO Integration — Evidence and Illustrative Acceptance Criteria
Author: Dhruba Poudel

Actual retained evidence and illustrative checks are explicitly separated.

Actual retained evidence | Own-account SSO sign-in
Result/criterion: Successful sign-in reported by Dhruba in an outgoing September 2026 email
Status: Validated for own account

Actual retained evidence | Provider hand-off requirements
Result/criterion: Federation metadata and user-identifier requirements coordinated in authored correspondence
Status: Requirements and coordination evidenced

Illustrative acceptance criterion | Matching user identity
Result/criterion: Application identity matches the agreed identity-provider identifier
Status: Illustrative; not an additional executed test

Illustrative acceptance criterion | Unmatched application identity
Result/criterion: Resolve the mapping discrepancy before accepting the user-enablement step
Status: Illustrative; not an additional executed test

Illustrative acceptance criterion | Wider user enablement
Result/criterion: Confirm intended user coverage and obtain the responsible owner’s acceptance
Status: Illustrative; rollout outcome not verified
